title: Get a digital NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card
summary: Learn how to get a digital version of your NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card using the Service NSW app.
intro:
If you already have a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card, you can get a digital version of your card through the Service NSW app.

The digital card does not replace your current physical card. You can choose which version suits you best, and participating businesses will recognise both when shown.

If you do not have a Seniors/Senior Savers Card, you'll need to apply for your physical card before you can access your digital card.
who_can_apply: Must already have a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card.
what_you_need: The latest version of the Service NSW app

how_to_steps.text: Download the latest version of the Service NSW app to your smartphone.
Log in to the app with your MyServiceNSW Account details.
Follow the prompts to add your Seniors/Senior Savers Card to the Service NSW app.

more_info.text: If you need assistance, you can contact 13 77 88 or visit a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Does the digital card replace my physical card?
faqs.a: No, the digital card does not replace your current physical card. Participating businesses will recognise both when shown.

faqs.q: What should I do if I don't have a Seniors/Senior Savers Card?
faqs.a: You must apply for your physical card first before you can access your digital card.

faqs.q: How do I add my card to the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: Download the Service NSW app, log in with your MyServiceNSW Account, select 'Wallet', then 'Add', and finally 'Seniors/Senior Savers Card' to follow the prompts.
